packages.name: WifiCrush
packages.tagline: Stay close to your Wi-Fi crush. Too far? Let go.
packages.compatibility: iPhone, iOS 15 and later. Rootless and RootHide.
description: The iOS Wi-Fi engine has a funny habit: it holds on to a Wi-Fi network for as long as it can, even when only one bar is left. Videos stall, pages hang, and the only fix is to open the Wi-Fi list and pick a network by hand, again and again. There is no way to tell iOS "this Wi-Fi is too weak, use 5G now". You just hope for the best, even in the middle of an important Wi-Fi call.

WifiCrush gives you that control. Pick the network you love (your crush) and your iPhone sticks with it. When your crush gets too weak, WifiCrush moves you to a stronger saved network for a while, then brings you back. Say your favourite is a fast 5 GHz network with a short range: walk a little further away and WifiCrush hops to the 2.4 GHz one with the better signal, then returns to 5 GHz once you are close again.

The best part is mobile data. Choose the signal level you are happy with, and the moment every Wi-Fi around you drops below it, WifiCrush lets go of Wi-Fi and turns 4G/5G on, quickly and decisively. That makes all the difference on long FaceTime or Wi-Fi Calling calls, especially when you keep talking while you walk out the door.
Back in good Wi-Fi, WifiCrush turns mobile data off again to save battery. Simple, quiet and automatic.
Read before buying:
- Rootless and RootHide jailbreaks, iOS 15 and later. Tested by me on iOS 17.2.1 Dopamine (iPhone 15 Pro Max), iOS 15.2 RootHide (iPhone 12 Pro Max) and iOS 15.3.1 rootless (iPhone 6s).

- WifiCrush switches between your saved Wi-Fi networks and mobile data to keep you connected as seamlessly as possible. It doesn't make your Wi-Fi stronger or faster - that depends on your router and Internet provider.
- Needs PreferenceLoader. The Control Center tile needs CCSupport (optional).
Special offer:
Already own 5Row Pro? WifiCrush is $1 off for you: $1.49 instead of $2.49.
Features:
- A friendly page for your saved networks: your iPhone in the middle, networks around it by signal
- Pick up to 3 crush networks. You stay with your crush, even when a network nearby is a little stronger
- Weak Wi-Fi: moves to a clearly stronger saved network, and goes back to your crush once it is strong again
- Every Wi-Fi weak: 4G/5G comes on within seconds. A minute later WifiCrush checks Wi-Fi again and picks the best next step
- On a call: if every Wi-Fi is weak, the call goes to 4G/5G right away, and Wi-Fi only comes back after you hang up, so the call carries on
- Mobile data goes off only after 30 s of good Wi-Fi, and only after a quick check with Google, Cloudflare and Apple servers that you really have Internet
- 5 GHz preferred over 2.4 GHz when the gap is small
- Strongest mode: one tap joins the strongest saved Wi-Fi around you for the time you set
- Control Center tile (CCSupport): tap for the Wi-Fi list, hold to open the app. Control Center's own Wi-Fi button can turn Wi-Fi fully off (optional)
Activation & privacy:

Sign in to Havoc in your package manager, buy WifiCrush, then open the WifiCrush app and tap Activate, done. WifiCrush sends nothing else: no Wi-Fi names, no location, no usage. Once activated it works offline.
Support:

Email me at pitroytechcode@gmail.com with your iOS version, jailbreak and what happened. If activation fails, the activation screen shows your device code and an email button; please include the code.

packages.name: SafeDel
packages.tagline: Offload apps from the Home Screen, keep their data
packages.compatibility: iPhone, tested on iOS 15.0.2 (RootHide) and 17.2.1 (Dopamine). Rootless and RootHide.
description: SafeDel saves you from a small disaster: deleting an app by mistake and losing all of its data. It adds a menu that removes only the app itself and keeps its data (everything you did in the app, sign-ins, settings, cache…).
Nothing fancy here. It simply brings iOS's own Settings › General › iPhone Storage › Offload App to the Home Screen.
What it can do:
- Add an orange Offload App item to the icon menu
- Hide Remove App from the menu
- Make the X button offload the app instead of deleting it
- Show how much space offloading or deleting will free
Simple, but handy. Enjoy!
Tested on iOS 15.0.2 (RootHide) and 17.2.1 (Dopamine, rootless). On big apps you may need to press and hold the icon 2–3 times before the size shows up.

packages.name: 5Row
packages.tagline: Unlock the number row for iPhone.
packages.compatibility: iPhone, iOS 15 and later. Rootless and RootHide.
description: 5Row adds a number row to the stock iOS keyboard. A simple thing that makes a real difference, and one Apple keeps choosing to forget.
More than a number row, 5Row also adds a row of the symbols you use most (press Shift or 123), so you type faster. It also supports Latin keyboards and many non-Latin layouts.
Read before installing:
- Tested by me on iOS 15.0.2 (RootHide) and 17.2.1 (Dopamine, rootless). Users have reported it working on 15.4, 16.4–16.7 and 17.0. Rootless and RootHide builds are both available.
- **iPhone only.** Handwriting and third-party keyboards are not supported.
Features:
- Adds a number row (1–0) above the letters
- Adds a symbol row (. , ? @ ! : - / ( )) when you press Shift or 123
- Works in landscape too
- Rename the 123 and ABC keys
- Exclude apps that should keep the stock keyboard
5Row Pro on Havoc adds:
- Smart Shift: when iOS capitalizes the start of a sentence, the row stays on your default row, so the numbers are there when you need them
- Set every key of the number row and the symbol row to whatever you like, emoji and accented letters included
- Choose which row shows on the normal keyboard, with Shift and on the 123 plane, in any combination
- Adjust the key height to your liking while the keyboard keeps Apple's layout and proportions. A small setting that makes typing noticeably more comfortable, especially for different hand sizes
- Keep five rows on the 123 plane, or drop back to the stock four
Support:
In 5Row's settings, turn on the diagnostic log, reproduce the issue, then copy the log and email it to pitroytechcode@gmail.com together with your iOS version and jailbreak.

packages.name: OhMyRotate
description: Take control of portrait and landscape rotation without constantly opening Control Center. Honestly, I think it's smarter than Apple's approach - and most rotation tweaks I've seen in years. :D
• Automatically disable portrait lock for selected apps.
• Unlock rotation during supported video playback.
• Even keep videos locked in landscape while you watch.
Completely free.
English and Vietnamese support.
For iPhone, with Rootless and RootHide support.
If you run into any issues, please enable logging in the tweak's settings, reproduce the issue, and send me the log.
Buy me a coffee if you enjoy it!
